summary: Iteration 37 backend testing — Global Notification Days Settings. All 12 tests passed (100%). Verified GET/PUT /api/settings/notification-config (shape, persistence, auth, coercion), legacy mirror into /api/settings/lists/membership_warning_days, legacy backward-compat (GET/PUT + propagation into notification-config GET), and /api/notifications cfg-based behavior including birthday_advance_days window and new company_name field + 'Role (Company) — date' message format on birthday entries.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is large (~4968 lines). Consider splitting notification config + notifications endpoint into a dedicated router module for maintainability.

PUT /api/settings/notification-config silently drops unknown keys and coerces invalid ints to defaults without signaling the caller. Fine for now, but a Pydantic model with explicit 422 responses would make the contract clearer.
Employees block uses hard-coded 'Marsol Group' as company_name in birthday notifications — consider sourcing from a settings key or marsol_companies so it stays consistent if branding changes.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and then delete 2 TEST_ prefixed companies for birthday notification assertions (TEST_BDAY_COMPANY_IT37, TEST_BDAY_WINDOW_IT37). Original notification-config is snapshotted and restored after the test module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 37 is fully green on backend. New config endpoints live at /api/settings/notification-config with 6 keys. Legacy /api/settings/lists/membership_warning_days still works and both directions stay in sync (PUT to config mirrors into legacy; legacy PUT is read by config GET). Birthday notifications now carry company_name field + 'Role (Company) — date' message. Frontend (HR sənədlər tab, Üzvlər Excel cleanup, universal Excel column picker, Settings menu design cleanup) was NOT tested per explicit user instruction.
